fields.description:
## Context / Problem

Every operator-seeded SSM `SecureString` secret in `infra/terraform` persists its CLEARTEXT value in
the remote terraform state (S3 `rebar-tfstate-896586841071`, key `rebar/prod/terraform.tfstate`,
SSE-S3 not a CMK). The `value = "CHANGEME"` + `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [value] }` pattern stops
terraform WRITING the secret from git, but terraform still READS the live value into
`attributes.value` on every refresh/import, so the plaintext lands in state — `terraform state pull`
renders 23 secrets in cleartext to any state-bucket reader, collapsing the secret tier to the bucket
ACL. Root cause is proven (see evidence comments).

## Decision (operator-approved — Option 1)

Migrate every operator-seeded `SecureString` SECRET from `value = "CHANGEME"` + `ignore_changes =
[value]` to terraform WRITE-ONLY arguments `value_wo` + `value_wo_version`, which the AWS provider
NEVER stores to state ("write-only values are never stored to state"). Non-secret `String` params
(`jira-url`, `jira-user`, `jira-project`) and the terraform-GENERATED `SecureString`
`opcert_origin_guard` (value = `random_password.opcert_guard.result`, already in state via the random
resource + API-Gateway header, so `value_wo` gives no net benefit) stay as-is.

## Approach

Three resources carry the antipattern and move to `value_wo` + `value_wo_version = 1` (dropping
`value` and the `ignore_changes` lifecycle block):
- `aws_ssm_parameter.rebar_secrets` (for_each, 18 params) — `infra/terraform/ssm.tf:90`
- `aws_ssm_parameter.opcert_ed25519_key` — `infra/terraform/opcert.tf:52`
- `aws_ssm_parameter.cookie_signing_secret` — `infra/terraform/auth_sso.tf:39`

`value_wo` needs AWS provider ≥ 5.79 and write-only args need terraform ≥ 1.11 (host: terraform
1.15.8, provider/lock 5.100.0). `versions.tf` floors sit below both today, so raise them:
`required_version >= 1.10` → `>= 1.11`; AWS `~> 5.0` → `~> 5.79`. Rationale: write-only args are the
provider-native mechanism purpose-built for keeping a secret out of state — no new dependency,
secrets-manager, or KMS CMK; minimal blast radius.

**Steady-state vs. cutover (G6, addressed):** in steady state the write-only value is re-sent only
when `value_wo_version` changes, so an out-of-band-seeded value is never reverted and `user_data.sh`'s
`CHANGEME` fail-fast still fires on an unseeded slot. The ONE migration apply is different: because
`value_wo_version` goes ABSENT→1, the provider re-sends `value_wo = "CHANGEME"` once and RESETS each
already-seeded live value to the placeholder. That is intended and safe here because the exposure
mandates ROTATING these secrets anyway — the deferred operator ticket does the apply + re-seed/rotate
in one window; the code change runs no apply. Detail in the round-1 comment + the new runbook.

**Unenumerated consumers (G1G2, addressed):** `infra/terraform/opcert-plan-assertions.sh` (f) and
`tests/unit/test_opcert_deploy_infra.py` assert the opcert key's `ignore_changes = [value]`; both move
to the `value_wo` invariant in lockstep. Directly-related docs `infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md` and
`infra/runbooks/gerrit-auth-hardening.md` are refreshed off the stale `ignore_changes` wording.

## Scope (files)

- `infra/terraform/ssm.tf`, `opcert.tf`, `auth_sso.tf` — migrate the three secret resources.
- `infra/terraform/versions.tf` — raise terraform + AWS-provider floors.
- `infra/terraform/opcert-plan-assertions.sh` — assertion (f) → `value_wo` invariant.
- `scripts/check_ssm_secret_state.py` (NEW) — hermetic structural guard (no live AWS) over
  `infra/terraform/*.tf`: every `SecureString` `aws_ssm_parameter` is flagged for a quoted
  string-literal `value` and/or `ignore_changes = [value]`, must pair `value_wo` with
  `value_wo_version`, and the generated-value case (unquoted-expression `value`, no `ignore_changes`)
  is allowed. Modeled on `scripts/check_templatefile_escapes.py`.
- `Makefile` — wire the guard into `make lint` (next to `check_templatefile_escapes.py`, line 302).
- `tests/unit/test_check_ssm_secret_state.py` (NEW) — RED→GREEN + mutation teeth + committed-tree
  clean + make-lint wiring, mirroring `tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py`.
- `tests/unit/test_opcert_deploy_infra.py` — the two consumers → `value_wo` invariant.
- `docs/adr/0105-ssm-secrets-never-in-terraform-state.md` + `docs/adr/.numbers/0105` + regenerated
  `docs/adr/README.md` — record the decision, extending ADR 0008, relating to ADR 0046.
- `infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md` (NEW) — declare/seed/rotate + remediation cutover.
- `infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md`, `infra/runbooks/gerrit-auth-hardening.md` — refresh stale wording.

## Testing

- RED first: guard/test fail on the CURRENT tree for the right reason (three secrets persist a
  `value` literal + `ignore_changes`), proven before the fix.
- GREEN after: guard + test pass once the three resources use `value_wo`/`value_wo_version`.
- Mutation teeth: reverting any one param to `value = "…" + ignore_changes = [value]` returns the
  guard to RED (asserted by the new test).
- `terraform validate` in `infra/terraform` passes (static; no plan/apply against the real backend).
- Updated `tests/unit/test_opcert_deploy_infra.py` passes; `make lint` passes.
- No secret VALUE is printed, logged, or committed — the guard inspects HCL structure only.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The three seeded-secret resources use `value_wo` + `value_wo_version` and carry no
      `value`/`ignore_changes = [value]`; verified by `scripts/check_ssm_secret_state.py` exit 0 + diff.
- [ ] The guard is RED pre-fix, GREEN post-fix, and RED again on a one-param revert; verified by
      `tests/unit/test_check_ssm_secret_state.py`.
- [ ] The guard is wired into `make lint`; verified by a wiring test and `make lint` exit 0.
- [ ] `versions.tf` floors are terraform `>= 1.11` and AWS `~> 5.79`; verified by reading the file.
- [ ] `terraform validate` in `infra/terraform` exits 0.
- [ ] `opcert-plan-assertions.sh` (f) + `tests/unit/test_opcert_deploy_infra.py` assert the `value_wo`
      invariant and pass; verified by running the opcert test file.
- [ ] ADR 0105 + marker `docs/adr/.numbers/0105` exist, the index is regenerated, and
      `scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` + `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check` pass.
- [ ] `infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md` covers declare/seed/rotate + the remediation cutover
      and cross-links ADR 0105; verified by reading it.
- [ ] A deferred OPERATOR `task` ticket (apply → re-seed/rotate in one window → verify no SecureString
      value in `terraform state pull` → rotate crown-jewels) exists, linked `discovered_from` this
      ticket; verified by `show_ticket`. [non-codebase] evidence: the new ticket id in a comment.
- [ ] No credential value is printed, logged, or committed by the fix or its verification.
